sections.title: Sound of the letter
paragraphs: The letter is called (эль) /ɛlʲ/. Its main sound is heard in the word (лампа) /ˈɫam.pə/, which means lamp. This letter makes two sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: For the first sound, press your tongue tip against the back of your upper teeth. Pull the back of your tongue up toward the soft roof of your mouth. Let air flow around the sides of your tongue with your voice on. For the second sound, press your tongue flat against the roof of your mouth. Touch your throat to feel your voice shake.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: You make the hard sound before hard vowels, before other consonants or at the end of a word. You hear it in (лампа) /ˈɫam.pə/ and in (стол) /stoɫ/. You make the soft sound before soft vowels or the soft sign. You hear it in (лето) /ˈlʲe.tə/ and in (соль) /solʲ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not replace the hard sound with a w sound, as in water. Keep the tip of your tongue firmly on your upper teeth. Do not say the soft sound like the l in light. Lift the middle of your tongue close to the roof of your mouth, like in million.
